items.text: 4 world markets made big moves over the past week, led by US dollar in rupees, which fell 1.7%.
The NIFTY 500 fell 1.4% on 23 Nov. Information Technology was the strongest sector (−0.1%) and Consumer Durables the weakest (−1.3%).

FIIs bought a net ₹5,673 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹2,760 Cr of Indian shares on 23 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 66 niches; Storage Terminals & LPG, Jewellery Retail Chains and OTC & Consumer Health joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Steel Distribution, Large PSU Banks and Small PSU Banks.
